name: conversiontools
description: Convert files between 140+ formats using Conversion Tools. Two surfaces - the ctio CLI (preferred when shell access is available) and the hosted MCP server (zero-install). Supports documents, data formats (incl. Parquet), images (incl. JXL), audio, video, e-books, OCR, AI extraction, text-to-speech (TTS), speech-to-text (STT), subtitles (SRT, VTT, ASS), and website screenshots.

interface.shortDescription: Convert files between 140+ formats: CLI + MCP server, with AI-powered data extraction.
interface.longDescription: The Conversion Tools plugin lets your agent convert files between 140+ formats end to end - documents, data formats, images, audio, video, e-books, OCR, subtitles, and website screenshots - plus AI-powered data extraction, text-to-speech, and speech-to-text. It bundles two surfaces: the ctio CLI (preferred when the agent has shell access; composable via Unix pipes and streams large files) and the hosted MCP server (zero-install). Files are converted via the ConversionTools.io API.
defaultPrompt: Convert report.pdf to an Excel spreadsheet.
Extract the line items from invoice.pdf as JSON.
Convert all the PNG files in this folder to WebP.
Turn this Markdown file into a narrated MP3.
